Review found a major compatibility regression and published it on task 51c2875b-48ae-4097-b985-b8a9584ca8c2. In `apps/backend/internal/plugins/host_utility.go:101-105`, legacy fallback is conditioned on `hasUtilityAgentConfig`, but the upgraded Notes manifest only declares `agent_profile`. `service_config.go:72-82` intentionally preserves a legacy `utility_agent` on save, yet invocation ignores it and returns `no agent profile configured`. This violates acceptance criterion 6. Fix by allowing legacy utility-agent fallback for agent-profile schemas while preserving direct-profile precedence, and cover the agent-profile-only schema case. Focused `go test ./internal/plugins ./internal/backendapp` began and the plugins package passed; no changes made by review.
